title.full: What to do after a scam

summary.text: Act immediately: alert your bank, secure Singpass, lock CPF withdrawals if you are 55 or above, and file a police report.

steps.name: Alert your bank
steps.text: Alert your bank and ask it to freeze the affected bank account.

steps.name: Reset Singpass
steps.text: Reset your Singpass password if you think your Singpass has been compromised. For further assistance, contact the official Singpass helpdesk at 6335 3533.

steps.name: Lock CPF withdrawals
steps.text: If you are 55 or above, activate the CPF Withdrawal Lock under Account settings to disable online CPF withdrawals instantly.

steps.name: File a police report
steps.text: File a police report and provide all details.

sources.page_title: What should I do if I fall prey to a malware/phishing scam?

quotes.text: In the unfortunate event that you fall prey to a scam, we recommend taking the following actions immediately:
Alert your bank to freeze the affected bank account.
Reset your Singpass password if you think your Singpass has been compromised. For further assistance, please contact the official Singpass helpdesk at 6335 3533.
If you are 55 and above, activate the CPF Withdrawal Lock under Account settings to disable online CPF withdrawals instantly.
File a police report and provide all details.
